20260908_1nGeLMjONkAKX.context: The recording is a space hosted by Angela, titled "Hook, Line, Sinker – How Psychological Operations Reel Us In". Logan is NOT present. Angela addresses him in the second person as an absent party and invites him to join, saying the space is recorded. Everything she says about Logan is therefore one-sided and unanswered here. "Speaker 1" is not named in the transcript. Angela refers to her as "Sav" (her friend and Logan's partner or girlfriend), so treat that as an inference from Angela's words, not a confirmed label. Speaker 1 speaks mildly, takes responsibility for her own actions and says she does not blame Logan for her mental-health struggles. Speaker 2 is an unnamed guest who joins later and says he knows Angela and Logan only separately and at a distance. Angela also calls the man "Michael" once ("Michael Foy") in u0 and u8. Do not conflate this with any other identity. The "evidence" Angela says she holds (recordings, screenshots, AI porn videos, nudes, DMs) is never played or shown in this recording, so every evidence claim is only her allegation. Angela admits she is "a reactive person", admits sharing Sav's screenshots, says she would do so again, and says she has "set people's names in spaces" despite promising not to name names. Later passages (u33-u40) are unrelated personal and conspiratorial claims she makes to a random visitor. They are outside this question and omitted. Present all accusations as allegations. In particular, the physical-abuse "charges", hacking and dark-web claims, deleted-space claims and informant or paid-operative suggestions are Angela's statements, not established facts.
